# Render time in seconds of every regression scene, rendered once by the head build on a
# GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runner: the median of three runs (Coastrnaut/mandelbulber2 regression
# runs 43456340824, 43465928877 and 43474615491, 2026-11-13), each scaled by the speed of
# its runner, because runners differ in speed by up to 2 times.
# regression-balance.sh splits the scenes into shards of about equal time with it; a scene
# missing here counts with the average time.
